  rw [← Ioi_insert, nhdsSet_insert, nhdsSet_Ioi]

theorem nhdsSet_Iic : 𝓝ˢ (Iic a) = 𝓝 a ⊔ 𝓟 (Iio a) := nhdsSet_Ici (α := αᵒᵈ)

theorem nhdsSet_Ico (h : a < b) : 𝓝ˢ (Ico a b) = 𝓝 a ⊔ 𝓟 (Ioo a b) := by
  rw [← Ioo_insert_left h, nhdsSet_insert, nhdsSet_Ioo]
